inlines.v: FORETELL', verb transitive 1. To predict; to tell before an event happens; to prophesy. 2. To foretoken; to foreshow. FORETELL', verb intransitive To utter prediction or prophecy. All the prophets from Samuel, and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days. Acts 3:1.
